# Alibaba.com

> Global B2B marketplace connecting buyers with Chinese manufacturers and suppliers across diverse industries, featuring wholesale products and direct sourcing from verified suppliers.

Alibaba.com serves as a comprehensive e-commerce platform for business-to-business transactions, showcasing supplier storefronts, product catalogs, and company profiles from manufacturers primarily based in China. The platform enables global trade through detailed product listings, supplier verification, and direct communication channels.
